title: Reject unsafe target URLs at creation
goals: Stop the shortener being used to disguise credentials-bearing, numeric-host or local-network links
functionalRequirements: Reject URLs whose host is an IP address (v4 or v6 literal) instead of a domain name
Reject hosts that can only be local (localhost, *.localhost, *.local, *.internal)
nonFunctionalRequirements: Checks are static and cheap: no network calls
The existing per-IP create rate limit is not changed
acceptanceCriteria: A URL with embedded credentials is rejected with 400
A URL with an IPv4 or IPv6 literal host is rejected with 400
localhost-style and .local / .internal hosts are rejected with 400
Ordinary https URLs on domain names are still accepted
assumptions: Phishing and unsafe targets only; the existing per-IP create rate limit stays as it is.
Rejected at creation time; no background scanning.
No external services: only static checks on the URL itself.
